errors.text_span: Die Exporte Deutschlands liegen zwischen 0,4 % und 5,3 %, wobei der Balken für die 2000er Jahre den niedrigsten Wert von 0,4 % und der Balken für die 2010er Jahre den höchsten Wert von 5,3 % aufweist.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the lowest value for German exports is 0.4% in the 2000s, but the figure shows 0.4% in the 2020s. The highest value is also misstated as 5.3% in the 2010s, but it is 5.3% in the 2000s.

errors.text_span: Die Industrieproduktion Deutschlands liegt zwischen -1,5 % und 2,7 %, wobei der Balken für die 2020er Jahre den niedrigsten Wert von -1,5 % und der Balken für die 2010er Jahre den höchsten Wert von 2,7 % aufweist.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the highest value for German industrial production is 2.7% in the 2010s, but the figure shows 2.2% in the 2010s. The value of 2.7% corresponds to the World GDP in the 2020s.
The description omits the fourth dataset, 'Welthandel,' represented by light green bars in the chart.
The description does not mention the label of the vertical axis, 'Durchschnitte in %,' which is explicitly shown in the figure.
The description does not mention the range of the vertical axis (-2.0 to 6.0), which is clearly visible in the figure.
The description does not mention the legend at the bottom of the chart, which identifies the colors and their corresponding datasets.
